desc: Derive the BFS-layer characterization: edges occur only within or between consecutive nonempty layers, and each non-root vertex has a neighbor in the preceding layer.
Derive and implement an efficient labeled BFS-layer profile DP retaining all edge-count coefficients.
Verify root handling, parity balance, label factors, and no profile double counting.
Validate the DP/formula against samples and establish modular arithmetic details.
